sources.title: Antigua and Barbuda, Public Holidays (Amendment) Act 2019 (No. 23 of 2019), Official Gazette Vol. XXXIX No. 90, 31 December 2019
sources.said: The Schedule to the principal Act is repealed and replaced as follows – “SCHEDULE 1. NEW YEARS DAY The First day of January in each year When the First day of January falls on a Sunday the following Monday shall be a public holiday. 2. INDEPENDENCE DAY The first day of November in each year When the first day of November falls on a Saturday or Sunday the following Monday shall be a public holiday … 3. CHRISTMAS DAY … When the Twenty-fifth day of December falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the following Monday and Tuesday shall be public holidays. 4. BOXING DAY … When the Twenty-sixth day of December falls on a Sunday, the following Monday and Tuesday shall be public holidays. 5. GOOD FRIDAY 6. EASTER MONDAY 7. LABOUR DAY The First Monday in May 8. WHIT MONDAY 9. CARNIVAL HOLIDAY The First Monday in August The Tuesday following the First Monday in August 10. SIR VERE CORNWALL BIRD SNR. DAY The 9th day of December in each year When the Ninth day of December falls on a Saturday or Sunday, the following Monday shall be a public holiday. 11. THE DAY FOLLOWING A GENERAL ELECTION IN ANTIGUA AND BARBUDA 12. SUNDAY For the purpose of employment standards and labour relations, Section C14 (Public holiday leave) and C15 (Public holiday pay) of the Antigua and Barbuda Labour Code, Cap. 27 do not apply to Sundays, except one of the other public holiday falls on a Sunday.

sources.title: ABS TV Radio, Calendar Of 2026 Public Holidays (the Labour Commissioner’s release)
sources.said: The office of the Labour Commissioner has released a full list of the 12 public holidays in Antigua & Barbuda this year. The release Tuesday notes a correction to the date originally published for the National Day of Prayer. That day is now firmly set as September 10, 2026. The Labour Commissioner, Eltonia David, has also advised although Independence Day is November 1 each year, this year it will be commemorated on November 2 – this is because November 1 will fall on a Sunday. … Should general elections be called this year, the Public Holidays (Amendment) Act of 2019 dictates the day following will also be declared a public holiday.

sources.title: Commonwealth Secretariat, Antigua and Barbuda General Elections, 30 April 2026: Commonwealth Observer Group report
sources.said: … constituted a Commonwealth Observer Group (‘the Group’) for the 30 April 2026 Antigua and Barbuda general elections, following an invitation from the government.
